ad_intro:
Red Chief (redchief.in) is a Footwear brand running ~35 active Meta creatives in India with estimated spend Rs.40-70L/mo and ads pointing to website traffic to subscription/checkout. Leather-footwear brand known for durability.

The funnel leaks at three points: (1) Creative: durability demo missing, static posters - The gap: walk-test / comfort-demo UGC. (2) Landing page: a product catalog with no size-fit guide or wear-test video. (3) Tracking: Pixel/GTM not verifiable on first paint; retargeting appears one-size-fits-all rather than segment-specific..

These are fixable in 7 days; we estimate ~30-40% of ad spend is wasted. Mid-market/SMB lead - high closability with a fast test budget.
ad_intelligence: Meta (Facebook + Instagram) primary; Google Search + YouTube secondary; app-install where relevant.
Several evergreen creatives running 30+ days - winners, but fatigue risk and a thin refresh cadence.
Category-siloed with limited concept testing; light UGC injection.
findings: Creative leak: Durability demo missing, static posters. The gap: walk-test / comfort-demo UGC.
Copy leak: Current angle is static catalog-led. Missing angle: comfort and durability proof over price.
Landing page leak: A product catalog with no size-fit guide or wear-test video.
Tracking leak: Pixel/GTM not verifiable on first paint; retargeting appears one-size-fits-all rather than segment-specific.
competitors: Demo UGC differentiates from price-led players.
wins: WIN 1 - Creative: Deploy walk-test / comfort-demo UGC
Shoot 15 fifteen-second walk-test / comfort-demo UGC and replace 30% of the weakest creatives. Expected: CTR +30-50%, CPA -15-25% within 10 days.
WIN 2 - CRO: Fix the landing experience
Add walk-test videos, a size-fit guide, and UGC reviews on PDPs. Expected: CVR +30-40%.
WIN 3 - Tracking: Server-Side CAPI + Segment Retargeting

Fire Meta Pixel + CAPI server-side on key conversion events; build 3 retargeting audiences (visited but didn't convert / started checkout / dropped off) with segment-specific creatives. Expected: recapture 10-15% of dropped conversions; cleaner attribution.
